title: ARCH↔QA-001: NFR Targets + Contract-Violation Reports
description: Architect supplies NFR targets (latency, power, OTA reliability), interface contracts as the basis for conformance tests, and the requirements-traceability map; QA returns measured verification results, contract-violation reports, and integration-defect analysis. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.10. NFR matrix must carry no [TBD] values (HG-04 Architect Production Gate).

nfr_targets.description: ARCH→QA: NFR Verification Matrix entries. Every target carries a value and a unit (no TBD).

metric.description: What is measured (e.g., API P99 latency).

verification_method.description: How it is verified (HIL soak, load test, on-target benchmark, FC-ID traceability).

x-macp.tier_rationale: NFR verification feeds the HG-04 Architect Production Gate and the QA go/no-go gate (both permanent HITL). A failing NFR or open contract violation blocks release sign-off.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (NFR matrix handoff at planning; HIL and end-to-end validation during execution; release-gate sign-off)
confirm_conditions: every nfr_target carries nfr_id, category, metric, target_value, unit, and verification_method (no [TBD])
verification_results report measured_value + unit + verdict per NFR
contract_violation_reports reference a valid canonical contract_id
all release-gating NFRs report verdict = PASS
reject_conditions: any NFR target with a [TBD]/placeholder value or missing unit (blocks HG-04)
a release-gate sign-off requested while a release-gating NFR verdict = FAIL
detection-coverage or robustness NFR reported as met when measured below target (Honesty Over Polish, §10.3)
counter_conditions: measured value within measurement noise of target — request a longer/again-run verification before verdict
contract-violation severity disputed — request the failing scenario trace before classification
